text.tspan: Left. The multiplier climbs and saturates at its cap of 5, so the constraint is binding hard throughout, yet the
applied coefficient still falls to exactly zero wherever the deployed value sits above the expert and re-engages
the moment it drops back below. That is the one-sidedness working. Centre. Value and greedy score come apart,
which is the documented cost of constraining value rather than score; score is evaluated every 200 iterations, so
it is drawn only where measured. Right. Entropy holds and both trust-region diagnostics stay small, so none
of this is bought with an unstable policy. Ours, seed 0.
